capabilities: Draw ONNX models written in onnx code blocks as Netron-style graphs
Accept ONNX text syntax, protobuf text, or JSON model formats
Toggle each graph between rendered view and source text
Colour operators by kind and label arrows with tensor shapes
Control direction, caption, alignment, alt text and CSS class per block
disambiguation: It only draws a model's structure as a graph; it never runs or executes the model.
extras: Works entirely offline with no network access and never runs models; binary .onnx files are not supported and must be converted to text first. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian can't display the structure of an ONNX model stored as text in a note, so you would need an external tool like Netron to see it as a graph.

relations.evidence: Models are read by Netron, created by Lutz Roeder
laid out by the Eclipse Layout Kernel through elkjs

summary: Renders ONNX models written as text in onnx code blocks as Netron-style graphs, with a button to flip each block between graph and source.
